body:
`cps/progress_syncing/README.md` is the only reference a third-party kosync
client author has, and #1451 expanded it to cover both position encodings, the
`position_kinds` parameter and the response shapes.

`scripts/generate-wiki.py` builds the public wiki from `repo/README.md` and
`repo/docs/` only, so none of that reaches the wiki. A client author who starts
at the wiki — the surface we point users to — finds no protocol reference at
all and has to know to look inside `cps/`.

The file is public on GitHub, so #1445's ask is met. This is about reach, not
correctness: `repo/docs/` currently holds only `install/`, so surfacing the
protocol reference means deciding whether `docs/` grows a `protocols/` section
and whether the canonical copy moves there (with the module README pointing at
it) or is templated in from where it is.

Noticed while shipping #1451.
title: kosync protocol reference lives outside the wiki-generated docs set
